responsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
responsibilities.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree not to upload any content that violates third-party rights or applicable laws.

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.body: The "PreCue.ai" platform, its UI, algorithms, and AI models are the exclusive property of PreCue.ai. However, you retain all ownership rights to the presentation files and content you upload.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: PreCue.ai is provided "as is". While we strive for 100% accuracy, we are not liable for any presentation failures, slide sync delays, or data loss occurring during live events.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: At PreCue.ai, we take your privacy seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and handle your data when you use our AI-powered presentation assistant.

account.label: Account Info:
account.body: Email address and name provided during registration.

files.label: Presentation Files:
files.body: Documents (PDF, PPTX) you upload for processing.

voice.label: Voice Data:
voice.body: Real-time speech processed locally or on our secure servers for slide control.

usage.label: Usage Data:
usage.body: Analytics on how you interact with the application.

protection.title: How We Protect Your Data
protection.body: Your files are encrypted using 256-bit AES encryption. We do not store raw voice recordings unless explicitly enabled for rehearsal feedback, and such data is automatically deleted after 30 days.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: We use trusted AI partners like Google and OpenAI to process text and speech. Your data is used only for processing requested actions and is never used to train global models.

definition.title: What are Cookies?
definition.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us provide a seamless and personalized experience. They allow us to remember your login state and preferences.

essential.title: Essential
essential.body: Required for core site functionality like secure login and session management. Cannot be disabled.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.body: Remember your language settings and AI voice preferences for a consistent experience.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.body: We use analytics partners to understand how users interact with PreCue.ai. This helps us optimize performance and identify common technical issues.

manage.title: How to manage cookies
manage.body: You can control cookie settings through your browser. However, disabling essential cookies will prevent you from logging into your account.
